title: Agreement probability in a correlated sign pair
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $-1\leq\rho\leq1$, choose a coordinate $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, and let $u,v\in\mathbb{R}$. For a pair of sign vectors sampled from the correlated pair distribution with parameter $\rho$, the expectation of the function that equals $u$ when their signs agree at coordinate $i$ and $v$ otherwise is $\frac{1+\rho}{2}u+\frac{1-\rho}{2}v$.
